now.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man#20
now.text: Venom goes after everyone Peter loves until Spider-Man strips the symbiote away, and Eddie is sent to Ravencroft.
now.on_a_card_about_b: Peter's old friend, turned enemy as Venom.
now.on_b_card_about_a: The brother Eddie wants to destroy.

proposed.text: As Venom, Eddie tries to unmask Spider-Man in public and force a gene cleanser down his throat. Spider-Man shoves it down Venom's throat instead, stripping the symbiote away, and Eddie is taken away vowing revenge.

changes.evidence: In 'Identity Crisis' (#20) Venom does not go after Peter's loved ones (that is 'Nature vs. Nurture', #13). Eddie returns to the ESU lab and taunts Peter, then as Venom tries to unmask Spider-Man in public and force the gene cleanser on him; Spider-Man shoves it down Venom's throat, the symbiote leaves Eddie, and Eddie is wheeled to an ambulance promising revenge. No source for Ravencroft in this episode.

now.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man#9
now.text: Norman is Harry's cold, ruthless father, and Spider-Man saves him from the Vulture. Meanwhile a masked Green Goblin torments Spider-Man and plays New York's crime bosses against each other.
now.on_a_card_about_b: Harry's cold father, whom Peter saves from the Vulture.
now.on_b_card_about_a: The hero Norman torments as the Goblin.

changes.evidence: The enemy stage first holds at 'Catalysts' (#7), where the Green Goblin (secretly Norman, as #26 shows) debuts, attacks the Big Man's operations and tries to kill Spider-Man; he torments Spider-Man again in #8 and #9. Spider-Man's rescue of Norman from the Vulture is #1. Nothing in the stage first holds at #9.

now.title: Your Friendly Neighborhood Spider-Man#9
now.text: When Norman visits Otto in prison to gloat over his deal for Otto's inventions, Otto vows to get him.
now.on_a_card_about_b: Norman's former scientist. Norman gets him arrested.
now.on_b_card_about_a: Otto's old boss. Gets Otto arrested and takes his tech.

proposed.text: When Norman visits Otto in prison to gloat that he tipped off Ross and that Oscorp is taking Otto's inventions, Otto lashes out at him for living off other people's work.

changes.evidence: In 'Hero or Menace' (#9) Norman gloats that he tipped off Ross and that Oscorp is seizing Otto's inventions; Otto lashes out, calling Norman out for exploiting others' work and saying he will always be worth more than Norman. No source has Otto vowing to get him.

now.title: Your Friendly Neighborhood Spider-Man#10
now.text: Jeanne is Daredevil's partner, the hero Finesse. She works undercover as an Oscorp intern to spy on Norman and Harry for him.
now.on_b_card_about_a: Jeanne's partner. Sends her to spy on Oscorp.

proposed.text: Jeanne is Daredevil's partner, the hero Finesse. She has been undercover as an Oscorp intern to spy on Norman for him, and now he asks her to keep an eye on Harry too.

changes.evidence: In 'If This Be My Destiny...' (#10) Jeanne is revealed as Finesse, who took the Oscorp internship to spy on Norman for Daredevil; when Harry's W.E.B. invites her, Daredevil suggests she accept and keep an eye on Harry. The Oscorp spying was on Norman, not Harry.
